title: ui_party
summary: MSUI's direct C# path contains the linked Party handlers and deterministic laws, including Benilla's explicit /partytest synthetic roster sandbox. The sandbox is provenance-gated, applies group-mutating actions locally, yields immediately to any real roster, and leaves the protected Party presentation unchanged. Runtime completeness/equivalence and authenticated feed/render behavior remain unverified.
